crossRefs.note: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”
even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?”…
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…
Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them…
Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out there; and though they be hidden from…
Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of…
There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to…
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…
They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from…
Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes black the day…
For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.
The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the…
Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

translations.web: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
translations.bsb: There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide.
translations.kjv: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide
